0022600097.text: The Raptors (1-0, 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East) visit the Wizards (1-0, 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East) in Toronto's second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams unbeaten so far. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (out, knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 134-125 win in Washington on February 28, 2026, and the two teams have not yet met this season.
